ideas.title: Returns exception digest
ideas.pitch: Flag returns that have stalled between receipt, refund and restocking, then send one daily exception list. Target stores that already pay staff or a returns platform to manage the queue.
ideas.buyer: Operations manager at an EU online homewares store with 5–40 employees
ideas.job: Staff already reconcile returns and chase unresolved cases.
ideas.where_money_is_proven: Inspect returns-platform subscriptions and time a store's daily exception review.
ideas.why_low_hassle: It reports exceptions from existing exports; store staff resolve them.
ideas.biggest_risk: The incumbent returns platform may already expose the same exceptions.
ideas.first_48h_test: Get anonymized return exports from three stores and produce a paid one-week exception digest.

ideas.title: Paid idea tests in seven days for founders and innovation teams
ideas.pitch: Most idea validation stops at desk research. A productized service runs a real test: a landing page, real ad spend, a cost per lead or per payment intent against a threshold written in advance, and a verdict in a week.
ideas.buyer: indie founders, small product teams and corporate innovation teams in France and the EU
ideas.job: learn what a customer costs before building
ideas.where_money_is_proven: freelance gigs for landing page plus ads tests on Malt, Codeur.com and Upwork; validation agencies' prices
ideas.why_low_hassle: a repeatable pipeline does most of each test
ideas.biggest_risk: service work per client; ad-account risk on shared accounts; resembles an agency
ideas.first_48h_test: Offer three tests at 1,500 EUR on LinkedIn and Indie Hackers; count paid deposits

ideas.title: Bakery shift handoff
ideas.pitch: Give each shift a short checklist, an issue log and an owner for unresolved tasks. Focus on the small bakery where missed handoffs cost staff time.
ideas.buyer: Owner of a French bakery group with 2–10 shops
ideas.job: Managers already spend paid time checking and correcting missed shift tasks.
ideas.where_money_is_proven: Shadow opening and closing at three shops; ask owners to price the manager time spent fixing missed tasks.
ideas.why_low_hassle: A fixed checklist and exception digest are self-serve and require little content upkeep.
ideas.biggest_risk: Staff may resist another daily tool.
ideas.first_48h_test: Set up one shop's checklist in a simple form and ask the owner to pay for a two-week trial.

ideas.title: Server-side tracking with tracking-health alerts for PrestaShop and WooCommerce shops
ideas.pitch: Elevar sells server-side conversion tracking to Shopify stores; PrestaShop (strong in France) and WooCommerce shops mostly run fragile browser pixels. A module plus a hosted endpoint sends Meta, Google and TikTok conversions server-side and alerts when event volume or match quality drops.
ideas.buyer: French and EU e-commerce merchants spending 5k EUR+ a month on ads, and their freelancers
ideas.job: keep conversion tracking accurate so the ad platforms optimize
ideas.where_money_is_proven: Elevar's and Stape's public pricing and review counts; PrestaShop Addons tracking modules and their reviews; Codeur.com gigs for Conversions API setup
ideas.why_low_hassle: self-serve module; monitoring is asynchronous (alerts, not on-call); one pipeline for every shop
ideas.biggest_risk: Stape and freelancers already cover server-side tagging cheaply; support on custom shops; ad-platform API changes
ideas.first_48h_test: Count PrestaShop Addons tracking modules with their reviews and the Codeur.com Conversions API gigs of the last 90 days; offer a 199 EUR/month beta to 20 PrestaShop shops running a Meta pixel

ideas.title: Certificate renewal for devices that cannot renew themselves, sold through MSPs
ideas.pitch: Public TLS certificates are capped at 100 days from March 2027, shorter later, and many printers, NAS, firewalls and appliances still take manual certificate uploads. A light agent issues through ACME and pushes certificates to those devices through their APIs, with an inventory and expiry alerts, priced per device to managed-IT providers.
ideas.buyer: managed IT providers and IT admins of SMBs
ideas.job: renew device certificates before they expire
ideas.where_money_is_proven: MSP tool pricing; certificate-lifecycle vendors' prices; MSP community complaints about the new limits
ideas.why_low_hassle: software only, sold to MSPs who do the field work
ideas.biggest_risk: device APIs vary (an integration treadmill); established vendors add device push; outages get blamed on the tool
ideas.first_48h_test: Ask in r/msp and MSP groups which devices they still renew by hand; count the devices named; offer a priced beta

ideas.title: Product-claims and listing compliance checker for EU e-shops
ideas.pitch: Generic green claims are banned EU-wide since September 2026, product-safety rules require safety and responsible-person information on listings, and discounts must show the previous price. A Shopify/PrestaShop app scans every product page and ad for these, proposes compliant wording and keeps an evidence file per claim.
ideas.buyer: e-commerce brands selling in the EU with 100+ products
ideas.job: keep product pages compliant before a consumer-protection control
ideas.where_money_is_proven: compliance apps on the Shopify App Store (reviews, plans); consumer-protection control reports and fines; law firms' audit prices
ideas.why_low_hassle: marketplace distribution, self-serve, scheduled scans
ideas.biggest_risk: liability when a checked page is still fined; rules differ by country; low willingness to pay before enforcement
ideas.first_48h_test: Scan 200 French Shopify stores for banned generic claims and missing safety information; email the 50 worst a free report and a 149 EUR/month offer

ideas.title: Invoice collector for SaaS and ad-platform invoices of French SMBs
ideas.pitch: Finance teams lose hours every month downloading invoices from software and ad-platform portals and matching them to card payments in Qonto, Spendesk or Pennylane. An agent logs in, fetches, matches and uploads them. GetMyInvoices does this in Germany, and the French e-invoicing reform does not cover foreign SaaS invoices.
ideas.buyer: finance or office managers in French companies of 10-200 people with 30+ software and ad subscriptions
ideas.job: collect and match supplier invoices every month
ideas.where_money_is_proven: GetMyInvoices pricing and customer count; Dext and Yooz pricing; Codeur.com gigs for invoice collection
ideas.why_low_hassle: a monthly asynchronous batch; setup is connecting accounts
ideas.biggest_risk: portal logins with 2FA break the agents (a maintenance treadmill); Pennylane or Qonto ship it
ideas.first_48h_test: A priced landing page ('every SaaS and ad invoice in Pennylane, 149 EUR/month') on LinkedIn ads to French finance managers, plus 20 direct messages; count booked calls

ideas.title: Hotel review work queue
ideas.pitch: Combine reviews from several properties into one queue with ownership, approved response templates and overdue alerts. Offer a narrow alternative to broader guest-experience suites.
ideas.buyer: Guest-experience manager at an EU hotel group with 3–20 properties
ideas.job: Staff already monitor and reply to public reviews.
ideas.where_money_is_proven: Inspect guest-experience software invoices or measure review-response hours at hotel groups.
ideas.why_low_hassle: The customer approves every reply; the product provides a queue and templates rather than a managed response service.
ideas.biggest_risk: Review platforms' access rules and existing suites may make the narrow offer unattractive.
ideas.first_48h_test: Show five hotel managers a combined mock queue and ask what they pay today for review handling.

ideas.title: Industrial catalogue cleanup
ideas.pitch: Convert supplier PDFs into consistent French and English product tables, with Romanian freelancers checking the output against each distributor's terminology. Sell a capped monthly batch rather than open-ended catalogue work.
ideas.buyer: Catalogue manager at an EU industrial-parts distributor with 5–50 employees
ideas.job: Distributors already pay staff or freelancers to normalize and translate supplier product data.
ideas.where_money_is_proven: Inspect catalogue-cleanup and translation budgets on Codeur.com and Freelancer.com; request recent supplier-PDF processing costs.
ideas.why_low_hassle: Fixed input formats, a batch cap and freelancer checks keep founder work to sampling and exceptions.
ideas.biggest_risk: Document variety could erase the margin; volume and processing time are guesses.
ideas.first_48h_test: Price and deliver a paid batch of ten supplier sheets, recording processing time and error rates.

ideas.title: Subcontractor certificate tracker
ideas.pitch: Collect insurance certificates from subcontractors, flag expiry dates and give project managers a current document list. Keep the contractor responsible for deciding whether a certificate is sufficient.
ideas.buyer: Project administrator at a French construction contractor with 10–100 employees
ideas.job: Staff already chase subcontractor insurance documents before and during projects.
ideas.where_money_is_proven: Ask contractors to show a recent certificate chase and estimate staff hours; inspect freelancer admin budgets on Codeur.com.
ideas.why_low_hassle: Scheduled reminders and a document dashboard need no live operational coverage.
ideas.biggest_risk: Subcontractors may ignore automated requests, leaving manual follow-up.
ideas.first_48h_test: Run a paid manual chase for one contractor's ten subcontractors and measure response rates.

ideas.title: EUDR due-diligence filings for micro importers
ideas.pitch: From 30 June 2027 micro and small operators placing coffee, cocoa, wood, leather, rubber, soy or palm products on the EU market must file due-diligence statements with supplier geolocation data. A done-for-you service collects supplier plots, runs the risk check and files the statements in the EU system.
ideas.buyer: micro and small importers and roasters in France (coffee, chocolate, furniture, leather)
ideas.job: EUDR due diligence and filings
ideas.where_money_is_proven: consultants' EUDR packages; prices of platforms for large operators
ideas.why_low_hassle: agents compile the files; one human check per filing
ideas.biggest_risk: the law has been delayed twice and may be simplified again; chasing supplier data is operations-heavy
ideas.first_48h_test: Call 15 French specialty coffee roasters about their EUDR plan and offer a priced filing service

ideas.title: WordPress care-plan proof
ideas.pitch: Generate a monthly client report showing plugin updates, backups and checks completed by a maintenance shop. Sell one focused reporting tool to firms already billing for WordPress care plans.
ideas.buyer: Owner of a WordPress maintenance firm with 1–10 employees
ideas.job: Staff already prepare client proof of maintenance work.
ideas.where_money_is_proven: Inspect paid WordPress maintenance plugins and care-plan listings; time a firm's current monthly reporting.
ideas.why_low_hassle: Reports run on a schedule and customers remain responsible for the actual maintenance.
ideas.biggest_risk: Existing tools may bundle reporting at a lower effective price.
ideas.first_48h_test: Review competing plugin prices and ask ten maintenance shops for one anonymized report and a purchase commitment.

ideas.title: CRA vulnerability-handling kit for small connected-product makers
ideas.pitch: Since 11 September 2026 makers of products with digital elements sold in the EU must report actively exploited vulnerabilities fast and run a disclosure process; the full CRA applies in December 2027. A kit: disclosure inbox and security.txt, SBOM upload with CVE monitoring, triage by agents with a security engineer's check, pre-filled notifications.
ideas.buyer: small hardware/IoT and software-product makers (10-200 staff) selling in the EU
ideas.job: meet CRA vulnerability-handling and reporting duties
ideas.where_money_is_proven: CRA consultancy prices; SBOM and vulnerability-management tool pricing; counts of EU makers in scope (to measure)
ideas.why_low_hassle: the customer files; the kit monitors and prepares, alerts in business hours
ideas.biggest_risk: time-critical duties create on-call pressure; makers may not know they are in scope; enterprise vendors move down-market
ideas.first_48h_test: List 100 EU connected-product makers from trade-fair exhibitor lists, check who publishes a vulnerability disclosure policy, offer the kit at 400 EUR/month to the 30 without one

ideas.title: Jira external-access expiry
ideas.pitch: List contractors and guests across Jira projects, assign an expiry date and prompt an administrator to review access. Package it as a small Atlassian Marketplace app.
ideas.buyer: Jira administrator at a software company with 50–250 employees
ideas.job: IT staff already perform periodic access reviews.
ideas.where_money_is_proven: Inspect paid access-management apps and top-grossing listings in the Atlassian Marketplace; ask administrators for their review hours.
ideas.why_low_hassle: Scheduled reports and admin-approved changes avoid round-the-clock security operations.
ideas.biggest_risk: The marketplace may already serve this exact job well; that gap is unverified.
ideas.first_48h_test: Audit competing listings and interview five Jira administrators before building.

ideas.title: French Agency Copyright Transfer Vault
ideas.pitch: Automatically generates and collects legally binding 'cession de droits d'auteur' contracts matching freelancer invoices. Guarantees tax and IP audit compliance with zero manual paperwork.
ideas.buyer: Operations Directors at French digital, design, and software agencies with 10–50 employees.
ideas.job: Securing mandatory French copyright assignment slips for client deliverables to pass tax audits.
ideas.where_money_is_proven: Freelance platforms charging compliance fees; lawyers charging 500+ EUR for IP assignment templates.
ideas.why_low_hassle: Asynchronous document collection triggered by email or invoice webhooks; no real-time operations.
ideas.biggest_risk: Guess: Agency owners mistakenly assuming standard freelance invoices automatically transfer all intellectual property.
ideas.first_48h_test: Message 30 French agency owners asking how they currently track freelancer copyright certificates.

ideas.title: Ad-spend rebilling and invoice reconciliation for marketing agencies
ideas.pitch: Agencies running clients' ads on Meta, Google, TikTok and LinkedIn rebill spend per client, reconcile platform invoices across dozens of accounts and handle reverse-charge VAT. A tool pulls invoices and spend per account, maps them to clients and drafts the rebilling invoices.
ideas.buyer: finance or ops leads at agencies managing 20+ client ad accounts in the EU
ideas.job: monthly ad-spend rebilling and invoice reconciliation
ideas.where_money_is_proven: staff days spent on it (to measure in calls); agency finance tools' pricing; Codeur.com gigs
ideas.why_low_hassle: a monthly batch with the same connectors for everyone
ideas.biggest_risk: a small niche; ad platforms' billing data differs; agencies may live with their accounting tool
ideas.first_48h_test: LinkedIn messages to 30 agency finance leads with a 299 EUR/month offer; count calls booked

ideas.title: Supplier specification change log
ideas.pitch: Record changes between supplier specifications and the versions purchasing and production approved. Give small manufacturers a focused history they can search without buying a full product-lifecycle suite.
ideas.buyer: Purchasing manager at an EU equipment manufacturer with 20–150 employees
ideas.job: Staff already compare and circulate supplier specification revisions.
ideas.where_money_is_proven: Measure purchasing and engineering hours spent on recent revisions; inspect current product-lifecycle software invoices.
ideas.why_low_hassle: Version comparison, approvals and exports are asynchronous and require no live operations.
ideas.biggest_risk: The workflow may need more integrations than a small team can maintain.
ideas.first_48h_test: Ask five manufacturers for two anonymized specification versions and price a pilot around their review process.

ideas.title: Artisan WhatsApp Quote & Payment Bridge
ideas.pitch: Podium-style WhatsApp automation for French home-service contractors to send quotes, capture signatures, and collect payments directly inside WhatsApp chats.
ideas.buyer: Owner of French artisan or renovation business (2-10 employees).
ideas.job: Chasing unpaid invoices and quote sign-offs on WhatsApp, currently lost to admin chaos.
ideas.where_money_is_proven: Podium and Jobber generating tens of millions in US/UK; French artisan spend on Codeur administrative setups.
ideas.why_low_hassle: Integrates official WhatsApp Cloud API with French billing APIs (Pennylane/Stripe); no hardware or complex custom dev.
ideas.biggest_risk: Meta changing WhatsApp Business API pricing tiers or strict template approval rules.
ideas.first_48h_test: Run 50 EUR of Meta ads targeting French contractors offering a WhatsApp quote-close demo.

ideas.title: Copyright-contract paperwork for Romanian companies paying creators and developers
ideas.pitch: Romanian companies pay many developers and creators under copyright-assignment contracts, which need a monthly annex, a payment notice, withheld tax and declarations. A tool generates and e-signs annexes and notices, computes withholding and reminds deadlines, sold to accounting firms per client.
ideas.buyer: Romanian accounting firms and companies managing copyright-contract payees
ideas.job: monthly copyright-contract paperwork and withholding
ideas.where_money_is_proven: accounting firms' fees per payee; the number of such contracts (to measure)
ideas.why_low_hassle: templates and rules in a monthly batch
ideas.biggest_risk: Romanian tax rules change often; a small market at low prices
ideas.first_48h_test: Call 15 Bucharest accounting firms with a priced offer

ideas.title: 100-Day TLS Automated Provisioner for Embedded Devices
ideas.pitch: A drop-in agent and API proxy that automates short-lived TLS certificate renewals for legacy IoT devices lacking native ACME/Certbot support.
ideas.buyer: VP of Engineering or IT Director at connected hardware companies (10-100 staff).
ideas.job: Preventing device outages caused by the March 2027 100-day certificate cap; currently managed via manual scripts.
ideas.where_money_is_proven: DigiCert/Sectigo enterprise PKI management spend and custom OpenSSL freelance contracts on Upwork.
ideas.why_low_hassle: Pure API/daemon software architecture; set-and-forget deployment with low customer touch after setup.
ideas.biggest_risk: Hardware teams creating brittle internal cron jobs instead of paying for third-party automation.
ideas.first_48h_test: Publish a technical teardown on LinkedIn/Reddit targeting embedded engineers; measure demo call bookings.

ideas.title: Ad and landing-page policy pre-check for health and wellness advertisers
ideas.pitch: Meta and Google disapprove ads and restrict accounts over health claims, before/after images and personal-attribute wording. A pre-flight checker scans ads and landing pages against each platform's current policy, explains the risk and proposes compliant wording, for direct-to-consumer brands in supplements, cosmetics and wellness.
ideas.buyer: DTC brands and their freelancers advertising health, beauty or wellness products in the EU
ideas.job: avoid ad disapprovals and account restrictions
ideas.pattern: sell to advertisers whose spend is rising
ideas.where_money_is_proven: agencies' compliance reviews; complaint volume on Meta's community forums; existing ad-compliance tools' pricing
ideas.why_low_hassle: self-serve checks, no live duty
ideas.biggest_risk: adjacent to the ad-account watchdog already in testing; policies change and enforcement is opaque
ideas.first_48h_test: Collect 50 disapproval complaints from public forums, run the checker on the ads quoted, and offer it at 99 EUR/month to the posters' brands

ideas.title: Archived, auditable WhatsApp for independent wealth advisers
ideas.pitch: Advisers discuss money with clients on WhatsApp, while their record-keeping duties expect client exchanges kept and retrievable. A WhatsApp Business setup that archives conversations, links them to the client file and exports them for an audit, for small advisory firms.
ideas.buyer: independent wealth-management advisory firms in France (1-20 advisers)
ideas.job: keep client communications archived and auditable
ideas.where_money_is_proven: enterprise archivers' pricing (LeapXpert, Smarsh, Global Relay); the regulator's record-keeping guidance; firm counts in the ORIAS register (to measure)
ideas.why_low_hassle: one product, self-serve onboarding through the WhatsApp Business API; no advice given
ideas.biggest_risk: the duty may not bite for small firms (weak urgency); Meta's WhatsApp Business policy; data-protection liability
ideas.first_48h_test: Read the record-keeping rules for these advisers, then call 10 firms from the ORIAS register with a 150 EUR/month offer and count yes or maybe

ideas.title: E-invoicing and e-reporting connector for PrestaShop and WooCommerce merchants
ideas.pitch: From September 2027 French SMEs must issue e-invoices through an approved platform and e-report their B2C sales and payments. A PrestaShop/WooCommerce module connects the shop to the merchant's approved platform and sends the e-reporting data automatically.
ideas.buyer: French e-commerce SMEs on PrestaShop or WooCommerce
ideas.job: comply with e-invoicing and e-reporting without changing shop software
ideas.where_money_is_proven: PrestaShop Addons modules for e-invoicing (reviews, prices); approved platforms' connector pricing
ideas.why_low_hassle: a module, sold through the marketplace
ideas.biggest_risk: 130-156 approved platforms and shop vendors will ship connectors; low price
ideas.first_48h_test: Count e-invoicing modules on PrestaShop Addons with their reviews and prices; message 20 PrestaShop agencies about what their clients plan

ideas.title: Forge app for a top-voted Jira or Confluence gap
ideas.pitch: Pick one of the long-standing, heavily voted feature requests in Atlassian's public Jira that a Cloud (Forge) app can deliver, build it and sell it through the Atlassian Marketplace. The end of Data Center expansions (March 2028) keeps pushing customers to Cloud, where many server-era apps are missing.
ideas.buyer: Jira or Confluence admins in companies of 50-2,000 users
ideas.job: close a feature gap Atlassian has left open for years
ideas.where_money_is_proven: Atlassian Marketplace REST API (installs, price ladder, sort by top-grossing) for apps in the same category; the request's vote count
ideas.why_low_hassle: Atlassian handles billing, procurement and distribution; one product for every customer; no setup per customer
ideas.biggest_risk: Atlassian ships the feature, or an existing vendor already covers it; Forge platform limits
ideas.first_48h_test: Rank the top 50 unresolved Cloud suggestions by votes, check each against Marketplace apps, keep 3 with no app or only stale, poorly rated ones, and send a priced pre-order to 20 admins who commented on them

ideas.title: Association renewal desk
ideas.pitch: Track member renewals, send reminders and show an administrator who needs personal follow-up. Focus on associations large enough to pay staff, but small enough to buy in one call.
ideas.buyer: Executive director of a French trade association with 200–2,000 members
ideas.job: Staff already process and chase annual membership renewals.
ideas.where_money_is_proven: Ask associations for renewal-season staff hours and current membership-software invoices.
ideas.why_low_hassle: Imports, reminders and an exception list run on a predictable annual cycle.
ideas.biggest_risk: Annual workload may make a monthly subscription hard to justify.
ideas.first_48h_test: Interview five directors and ask for a paid pilot covering their next 50 renewals.

ideas.title: Domiciliation mail intake
ideas.pitch: Turn incoming mail scans into named customer records with dispatch confirmations and a searchable history. Sell to domiciliation providers that currently sort and forward mail by hand.
ideas.buyer: Operations manager at a French domiciliation provider with 2–20 employees
ideas.job: Staff already scan, classify and forward customer mail.
ideas.where_money_is_proven: Observe one provider's daily mail run and calculate staff minutes per envelope from payroll costs.
ideas.why_low_hassle: The provider keeps physical handling; software covers intake, notifications and records.
ideas.biggest_risk: Customer volumes may be too low for a €350 monthly tool.
ideas.first_48h_test: Ask five providers for daily envelope counts and pitch a paid trial on one intake batch.

ideas.title: Outside-in vulnerable-site detection with an instant security-maintenance offer
ideas.pitch: Scan public web data for French small businesses and associations whose sites run CMS versions with known critical vulnerabilities, send each a specific report and an instant price for patching plus monthly maintenance, delivered by freelancers with agents.
ideas.buyer: French SMBs and associations with old Joomla, WordPress or PrestaShop sites
ideas.job: keep the website patched and safe
ideas.where_money_is_proven: maintenance-plan prices of web agencies (30-150 EUR/month); Codeur.com gigs for security updates
ideas.why_low_hassle: detection and outreach are automated; delivery is runbook work
ideas.biggest_risk: cold outreach to small organisations converts poorly; cheap competitors with distribution; liability when an update breaks a site
ideas.first_48h_test: Query public crawl data for French domains on vulnerable CMS versions, email 200 of them a specific report and a 99 EUR/month offer, count replies

ideas.title: EU rising-advertiser radar for brands and agencies
ideas.pitch: Weekly rankings of rising advertisers per category and country from the EU's official ad repositories (Meta reach, Google creatives, Snapchat and Microsoft impressions, LinkedIn), with spend ranges, sold to brands and agencies watching competitors.
ideas.buyer: marketing leads at EU brands and agencies
ideas.job: know which competitors are scaling which ads
ideas.pattern: sell to advertisers whose spend is rising
ideas.where_money_is_proven: Trendtrack, Semrush Advertising and Sensor Tower pricing; ad-spy tools' traction
ideas.why_low_hassle: a data pipeline and weekly reports
ideas.biggest_risk: repository gaps; crowded ad-spy market; the founders' constraints need checking
ideas.first_48h_test: Build one category's ranking for France from the BigQuery and Meta data and show it to 10 agency heads with a price

ideas.title: Green-claim evidence register
ideas.pitch: Give each environmental claim an owner, supporting files, review date and approval history. The product tracks evidence; it does not decide whether a claim is lawful.
ideas.buyer: Sustainability lead at an EU apparel retailer with 20–200 employees
ideas.job: Staff already review and document claims used on products and packaging.
ideas.where_money_is_proven: Ask retailers to show the staff time or external review invoices for a recent claim audit.
ideas.why_low_hassle: A register, reminders and exports can run without ongoing founder involvement.
ideas.biggest_risk: The rules and buyers' processes vary; France has not transposed the ban cited in the brief.
ideas.first_48h_test: Ask five retailers to walk through their last ten claims and offer to organize one evidence register for a fee.

ideas.title: Compliance tracker for French short-term rental conciergeries
ideas.pitch: Conciergeries manage 20-200 furnished tourist rentals each, and the 2024 Le Meur law tightened registration, energy-rating and day-limit rules, which vary by city (to verify). A tracker per listing: registration status, energy-rating deadlines, nights against caps and the city's rules, with alerts before a breach.
ideas.buyer: conciergerie owners in France (20-200 listings)
ideas.job: keep every listing legal across cities
ideas.where_money_is_proven: conciergeries pay for channel-manager tools (Smoobu, Lodgify, Hostaway); municipal fines; conciergerie counts in SIRENE (to measure)
ideas.why_low_hassle: listing data entered once, a rules engine, alerts
ideas.biggest_risk: municipal rules change; channel managers add the feature; a small market
ideas.first_48h_test: Call 15 conciergeries in Paris, Lyon and Bordeaux with a priced pre-order; note how they track registration and day caps today

ideas.title: Training-course evidence pack
ideas.pitch: Turn a training provider's existing attendance and signoff templates into a course-by-course document workflow. Export complete packets for the provider's own review without judging compliance.
ideas.buyer: Operations director at a French training provider with 3–20 employees
ideas.job: Administrators already assemble attendance and signoff documents for each course.
ideas.where_money_is_proven: Review a provider's current templates, administrator hours and any document-tool subscription.
ideas.why_low_hassle: The product repeats a fixed workflow and produces exports; the provider handles exceptions.
ideas.biggest_risk: Providers may already get this function from their training-management software.
ideas.first_48h_test: Ask five providers for a sample course packet and quote a paid setup for one course.

ideas.title: Ad Claim Green-Check
ideas.pitch: Automated scanning of live Meta and Google ad copy against the EU generic green claims ban. Flags non-compliant terms and recommends verified environmental wording.
ideas.buyer: Head of Performance Marketing at EU consumer brands (10–50 employees) spending €20k+/month on paid ads.
ideas.job: Auditing ad creatives and landing pages to avoid regulatory fines and sudden ad account bans.
ideas.pattern: sell to advertisers whose spend is rising
ideas.where_money_is_proven: Existing legal compliance retainer spend and public ad library data showing active sustainable ad campaigns.
ideas.why_low_hassle: Runs via public ad library scrapers and scheduled AI agents. Self-serve dashboard, no 24/7 on-call requirement.
ideas.biggest_risk: I do not know how aggressively national consumer protection agencies will enforce penalties in year one.
ideas.first_48h_test: Scrape 100 sustainable EU e-commerce brands' ads, email 20 Heads of Marketing showing their non-compliant live ads.

ideas.title: Packaging conformity file collector
ideas.pitch: Collect supplier documents, packaging specifications and signoffs into a file for each product. Sell the document workflow for the EU packaging deadline; leave conformity decisions to the buyer's specialist.
ideas.buyer: Operations lead at an EU personal-care brand with 10–100 employees
ideas.job: Staff already assemble packaging documentation for a mandatory deadline.
ideas.where_money_is_proven: Ask brands for the hours or consultant invoices behind one completed packaging file; check relevant Codeur.com project budgets.
ideas.why_low_hassle: Customers upload documents and approve files themselves; delivery is an asynchronous workflow.
ideas.biggest_risk: Unknown willingness to pay monthly after the initial backlog is cleared.
ideas.first_48h_test: Show five operations leads a sample file and ask for a paid pilot covering ten products.
